definitions.explanation: The ratio of useful output to total input; how effectively time, resources, or effort are used to produce results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効率|こうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げたい→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve my work efficiency.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{効率|こうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{変|か}えよう→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: This method is inefficient, so let's change it.

examples.japanese: AI⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧ことで、⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効率|こうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: By introducing AI, work efficiency was significantly improved.

notes:
The ratio of useful output to total input. Very common in business, engineering, and daily life to describe how well resources (time, energy, money) are used.
